defaults.composition: Bank vegetation or stones form the foreground along the bottom of the frame, the stream or pond crosses the middle ground on a gentle diagonal or lies broad and level, and fresh young trees and soft sky form the background; the view looks across the water from the bank

shots.subject: A shallow brook winding across a valley floor of new grass, young willows on both banks just leafing out and thin mist lying over the water
shots.motion_elements: the thin mist over the brook and the flowing shallow water

shots.subject: A small woodland pond ringed by young beech trees in pale new leaf, a mossy bank in front and white clouds reflected in the still water
shots.motion_elements: the beech leaves fluttering and the cloud reflections rippling on the pond

shots.subject: A clear stream sliding diagonally over flat limestone shelves in a beech wood, low evening light on fresh leaves and warm glints on the water
shots.motion_elements: the stream sliding over the shelves and the beech leaves stirring

shots.subject: A quiet marsh pond edged with bright yellow marsh marigolds and young reeds, a line of budding alders behind under a soft grey sky
shots.motion_elements: the young reeds swaying and the soft ripples on the pond

shots.subject: A brook swollen after a spring shower running across a meadow, wet Queen Anne's lace along the banks and a hawthorn hedge in white bloom behind
shots.motion_elements: the brook running across the meadow and the Queen Anne's lace heads nodding

shots.subject: A wide shallow ford of pebbles where a stream crosses a clearing, birch trees with tiny new leaves on the far bank and soft morning haze
shots.motion_elements: the water rippling over the pebbles and the birch leaves trembling

shots.subject: A spring-fed pool of very clear water in a grassy hollow, a low old stone wall covered in moss on one side and young oaks beyond
shots.motion_elements: the clear spring water welling gently and the oak leaves moving

shots.subject: A slow lowland stream curving across the frame between grassy banks, a row of pollarded willows with fresh catkins catching low warm light
shots.motion_elements: the slow stream and the willow catkins swaying

shots.subject: A rocky brook tumbling across a hillside of fresh bracken and young rowan trees, cool grey light and damp stones
shots.motion_elements: the brook tumbling over the stones and the bracken fronds stirring

shots.subject: A woodland pool after rain with drops still falling from overhanging hazel, wet moss-covered stones on the bank and a carpet of wild garlic behind
shots.motion_elements: the drops rippling the pool surface and the hazel leaves trembling

shots.subject: A small lake inlet in early spring with pale reeds from last year, fresh green shoots among them and mist drifting off the water
shots.motion_elements: the mist drifting off the water and the reeds swaying

shots.subject: A clear stream crossing a flowering orchard edge, a simple plank footbridge over it and blossoming apple trees on the far bank
shots.motion_elements: the stream flowing beneath the footbridge and the apple blossom stirring

shots.subject: A pond at the foot of a gentle hill, young birches leaning over the water and long warm light across new grass on the far bank
shots.motion_elements: the birch leaves fluttering and the light shimmer on the pond

shots.subject: A wide gravel-bedded river shallows with braided channels, fresh green willow scrub on the islands and a soft white sky
shots.motion_elements: the braided channels flowing and the willow scrub moving

shots.subject: A stream cascading in small steps across a mossy beech wood floor, wet bluebells scattered on the slopes and soft dripping light
shots.motion_elements: the stepped cascades and the bluebell stems nodding

shots.subject: A spring meadow with a meandering brook, scattered buttercups and lady's smock along its banks and a soft haze over a row of young trees behind
shots.motion_elements: the meandering brook and the haze over the trees

shots.subject: A shallow, sunlit pond with lily pads just unfurling, a bank of fresh yellow flag iris leaves and young alders on the far side
shots.motion_elements: the iris leaves swaying and the gentle ripples between the lily pads

shots.subject: A gentle stream crossing a wild cherry glade, a few cherry trees in soft white bloom on the bank and evening light on the water
shots.motion_elements: the stream flowing over stones and the cherry blossom stirring

shots.subject: A mossy rocky brook winding across a broad slope of young oak woodland, fern banks under pale new oak leaves and water flowing over a series of low ledges
shots.motion_elements: the water flowing over the low ledges and the fern fronds stirring

shots.subject: A rain-filled field pond surrounded by fresh grass and a low dry stone wall, reflecting a patch of clearing sky
shots.motion_elements: the reflections rippling on the pond and the grass moving

shots.subject: A clear chalk stream running broadly across the frame over bright green water crowfoot weed, with young sedges on the bank
shots.motion_elements: the water crowfoot weed swaying in the current and the sedges moving

shots.subject: Two small ponds joined by a short stony runnel in a grassy hollow, young hawthorns with new leaves around them and drifting fair-weather clouds
shots.motion_elements: the runnel flowing between the ponds and the drifting clouds

shots.subject: A brook meandering through a field edge of Queen Anne's lace and early grasses, low sun backlighting the umbels and glinting on the water
shots.motion_elements: the Queen Anne's lace umbels swaying and the glinting brook

shots.subject: A quiet millpond-like pool behind a small natural rock weir, budding sycamores leaning over and a soft grey sky reflected in the water
shots.motion_elements: the water spilling over the rock weir and the sycamore leaves stirring

shots.subject: A clear upland stream crossing a slope of new grass and primroses, small cascades over wet stones and clouds lifting off the hilltop
shots.motion_elements: the small cascades and the clouds lifting off the hilltop

shots.subject: A pond in a young birch wood with pale trunks reflected in the still water and a light mist hanging between the trees
shots.motion_elements: the light mist between the trees and the faint ripples on the pond

shots.subject: A wide shallow stream over a sandy bed in an open valley, fresh willows and young alders along the banks under a clear sky
shots.motion_elements: the shallow water rippling over the sandy bed and the willow leaves fluttering

shots.subject: A small woodland lake with a gently curving shore of moss and fresh fern fronds, warm evening light through a beech wood behind
shots.motion_elements: the fern fronds stirring and the shimmer on the lake

shots.subject: A brook running under a simple old wooden footbridge at the edge of a pasture, budding hawthorn and soft spring grass on the banks
shots.motion_elements: the brook running under the footbridge and the grass stirring

shots.subject: A shallow pebble stream in a valley after rain, glistening grass banks, wet young sycamores and a low band of mist on the far hillside
shots.motion_elements: the shallow stream over the pebbles and the low band of mist

shots.subject: A reedy pond corner with a willow just leafing out, morning mist resting on the water and the first lily pads around the edge
shots.motion_elements: the morning mist on the water and the willow fronds swaying

shots.subject: A wide spring-fed stream spreading across a level water meadow, golden light across new grass and blossoming blackthorn along the far edge
shots.motion_elements: the spreading stream and the blackthorn blossom stirring
